info.title: SyncSql.Cli
info.description: Extraction, lineage, and catalog building for a fleet of MSSQL/Oracle servers - the syncsql CLI.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: syncsql - extraction, lineage, and catalog building for a fleet of MSSQL/Oracle servers.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: validate-config
commands.description: Parse and validate a config/servers.json file.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to the config/servers.json file to validate, relative to the current directory unless absolute. [default: config/servers.json]

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Extract every configured server's database objects and metrics snapshots.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to config/servers.json, relative to the current directory unless absolute. [default: config/servers.json]

options.name: --output-root
options.description: Override the output root. Default: uppercase servers.type per engine (./MSSQL or ./ORACLE).

options.name: --output-log
options.description: Append run logs to this file as well as the terminal. Accepts an absolute or relative file path; missing parent directories are created.

options.name: --staging-root
options.description: Directory each extracted object is written to, as <server>/<database>/<schema>/<type>/<object>.sql. Default: uppercase servers.type (MSSQL/ORACLE), or --output-root when supplied.

options.name: --metrics-snapshot-root
options.description: Directory this run's volatile metrics snapshots are written to (separate from --staging-root - one JSON file per table, folded into history later via `syncsql metrics update`). Default: <output-root>/metrics-snapshot.

options.name: --skip-metrics
options.description: Skip capturing volatile table metrics during extraction. [default: False]

options.name: --db-user
options.description: Database username for one server, as PREFIX=value where PREFIX is that server's credentialsVariablePrefix. Repeatable. Takes precedence over --credentials-file and the environment.

options.name: --db-password
options.description: Database password for one server, as PREFIX=value. Repeatable. Note that command-line arguments are visible to other processes on the host - prefer --credentials-file where that matters.

options.name: --credentials-file
options.description: JSON file of credentials keyed by credentialsVariablePrefix: { "PREFIX": { "user": "...", "password": "..." } }. Used for any half not passed as a parameter.

options.name: --server-include
options.description: Regex override for which configured servers run. Takes precedence over config.serverSelection.

options.name: --server-exclude
options.description: Regex override for which configured servers are skipped. Takes precedence over config.serverSelection.

options.name: --max-parallelism
options.description: Maximum concurrent extraction jobs across all engines. Slots are shared fairly and reassigned as work finishes. Use 1 for sequential extraction. [default: 4]

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build one consolidated, partitioned catalog from extracted object trees.

options.name: --output-root
options.description: Override the output root. Default: uppercase servers.type per engine (./MSSQL or ./ORACLE).

options.name: --objects-root
options.description: Extracted tree roots to consolidate. May be repeated or supplied as a list. Default: --output-root, or all existing MSSQL/ORACLE roots.

options.name: --output
options.description: Manifest path. Default: <selected-root>/catalog.json for one root; ./catalog/catalog.json for multiple roots. Payloads are written beside it in _catalog/.

options.name: --repo-root
options.description: Git checkout containing --path-prefix, mined for history/heatmap/point-in-time data. Omit to skip all of that.

options.name: --path-prefix
options.description: Folder inside --repo-root holding the extracted tree. Default: empty, i.e. the tree starts at the repository root with the server name. [default: ]

options.name: --history-limit
options.description: Maximum number of commits (touching --path-prefix) to mine. [default: 250]

options.name: --max-versions-per-object
options.description: Maximum number of historical versions kept (and content-fetched) per object, most recent first. [default: 15]

options.name: --max-history-content-calls
options.description: Hard cap on total `git show` invocations across the whole mining pass. [default: 1500]

options.name: --max-co-change-commit-size
options.description: Commits touching more files than this are excluded from co-change pair counting. [default: 40]

options.name: --metrics-root
options.description: Override the metrics history root for all inputs. Default: each input's metrics/ directory when present.

options.name: --prune
options.description: Remove unreferenced hashed payloads after publishing the manifest. Use only in a dedicated catalog directory. [default: False]

commands.name: update
commands.description: Fold this run's metrics snapshots into the accumulating history tree.

options.name: --output-root
options.description: Override the output root. Default: uppercase servers.type per engine (./MSSQL or ./ORACLE).

options.name: --snapshot-root
options.description: Root of this run's freshly captured snapshot tree (one JSON file per object, same relative path/id as the object's own .sql file). Default: <output-root>/metrics-snapshot, i.e. `sync`'s --metrics-snapshot-root.

options.name: --history-root
options.description: Root of the accumulating history tree, kept outside config.git.pathPrefix. Default: <output-root>/metrics.

options.name: --history-limit
options.description: Maximum snapshots retained per object; oldest are trimmed first. [default: 90]

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Lint T-SQL script(s) for syntax errors and common style/best-practice issues.

options.name: --output-root
options.description: Override the output root. Default: uppercase servers.type per engine (./MSSQL or ./ORACLE).

options.name: --path
options.description: A .sql file, or a directory searched recursively for *.sql files. Repeatable. Default: ./MSSQL, or --output-root when supplied. Oracle SQL is not T-SQL.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Minimum finding severity that makes the command exit non-zero: 'warning' or 'error'.

options.name: --config
options.description: SQL lint/format JSON configuration. Default: ./config/sql-style.json when present, otherwise the packaged defaults.

commands.name: parser
commands.description: Explore a SQL file's syntax tree, tokens, lineage, and diagnostics.

options.name: --file
options.description: SQL file to inspect (read only).

options.name: --engine
options.description: SQL dialect: mssql (default) or oracle.

options.name: --plain
options.description: Print all pieces as text instead of opening the dashboard. [default: False]
